name: The Artisan Istanbul MGallery
positioning: Art-filled MGallery boutique hotel (officially The Artisan Hotel Istanbul - MGallery Collection) on a quiet street between Taksim and Dolmabahce, steps from the Bosphorus coast
best_for: Art lovers who want a hotel with its own resident collection
Travelers who want a quiet base within walking distance of Taksim and Istiklal Street

facts.text: Nearly 100 works of art are exhibited throughout the hotel.
The resident art collection includes works by local artists as well as works by globally renowned artists.
Works of art are found in the rooms, corridors, convention halls, lobby and terrace.
Inspired by the historical buildings of the neighbourhood, the hotel reflects Art Nouveau design elements.
The boutique hotel sits on a quiet street between Taksim and Dolmabahce, a few steps from Istiklal Street and Pera.
The hotel is mere steps from the Bosphorus coast and within walking distance of Taksim.
The hotel is a ten-minute drive from Karakoy, home to Galataport and the Istanbul Modern Museum.
Kabatas Pier, for the ferry to the Princes' Islands, is a 5-minute walk from the hotel.
Kabatas Station, where trams run to the Old City, is a 7-minute walk from the hotel.
The hotel is part of MGallery, the Accor Group's premium category brand.

highlights.text: Nearly 100 works of art, by local and globally renowned artists, are shown throughout the hotel, from the rooms and corridors to the lobby and terrace.
Richard Mas' surrealist sculptures of a woman and a man with heads shaped like lips welcome guests at the lobby entrance.
A boutique hotel on a quiet street between Taksim and Dolmabahce, a few steps from Istiklal Street and Pera.
Mere steps from the Bosphorus coast, with Kabatas Pier a 5-minute walk away for the ferry to the Princes' Islands.
Art Nouveau design elements inspired by the neighbourhood's historical buildings.

considerations.text: The Old City sights such as Hagia Sophia and Topkapi Palace are reached by tram from Kabatas Station, a 7-minute walk from the hotel.
Karakoy, with Galataport and the Istanbul Modern Museum, is a ten-minute drive away.
WhataHotel notes a compact boutique hotel size.
